Preprocessing (what the model's code applies)
  Resize       squash to 8×8 (bilinear): the whole photo, aspect ratio not kept
  Normalise    pixels/255, then (x - mean) / std with mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std [0.229, 0.224, 0.225] (ImageNet mean/std)
  Layout       NCHW
  Produces     [1,3,8,8] float32
  Example      a 640×360 photo becomes [1,3,8,8]: x scaled ×0.0125, y ×0.02222, then shifted by +0,+0 (the model's own code, run now)
  Graph takes  model.onnx input "pixels" [d0,3,8,8]
  Fits         yes: every fixed dimension matches

Runtime
  Providers      cuda → cpu (each session takes the first one this machine has)
  TensorRT       off (opt in with --tensorrt or VISIONSERVE_TENSORRT=1)
  Session model  model.onnx, 1 session, ONNX Runtime default threads
  Unloads        after 300 s without requests
  Client resize  SDKs shrink images to a shorter side of 16 px (max_useful_short_side)
